name: STAT 6315
title: Statistical Inference I
description: Exponential families, sufficient statistics, loss function, decision rules, convexity, prior information, unbiasedness, Bayesian analysis, minimaxity, admissibility, simultaneous and shrinkage estimation, invariance, equivariant estimation.
requirement_description: Open to Ph.D. students who have passed the Ph.D. Qualifying Exam in Statistics, others with permission.
